notes.title: Ephemerid 1.0.5 - Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
A small update has gone live.  It includes two minor bug fixes, which most people probably never even ran into:
* Fix to snowball scene prematurely clearing the snow if the menu was brought up during the scene and interacted with in a certain way.
* Fix to final scene - under certain conditions, Ephemerids flying through space forever.  It's a nice thought and all, but not the actual ending to the game.
